definition: Stated priorities, focus areas, target segments and lines of business either party is steering towards for the period.
New facilities, joint programmes, quota shares, line slips, dedicated teams and other structural arrangements launched or expanded between Marsh and the carrier.

Countries, products or regions that are underperforming — GWP decline, rank deterioration, capacity or appetite gaps, resourcing and expertise issues.
